items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And I listened to him time and time again. And I talked with him.

ctx.x: Right. I've dug him -- when he used to come down to Small's and sit back up there and play, and seemed like he was always reaching for something or trying to

do something that he hadn't -- what he hadn't wanted -- what he hadn't accomplished. And I listened to him time and time again. And I talked with him. I liked things he did. He was always moving on his horn, but it seemed like the man was always like reaching for something.
